text:
For a European hotel conversion where the owner wants to retain the property’s identity and operating flexibility, the usual shortlist includes:

| Hotel group | Commonly considered soft/collection brands | Typical positioning |
|---|---|---|
| **Marriott** | **Tribute Portfolio**, **Autograph Collection**, **The Luxury Collection** | Upscale through luxury; strong Bonvoy distribution. Marriott specifically positions these collections as operating models for independent hotels. ([hotel-development.marriott.com](https://www.hotel-development.marriott.com/brands/premium-brands?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Hilton** | **Tapestry Collection**, **Curio Collection**, **LXR Hotels & Resorts** | Upscale, upper-upscale and luxury. Curio and Tapestry offer flexible frameworks intended to preserve each hotel’s character. ([stories.hilton.com](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/hiltons-curio-and-tapestry-collections-celebrate-200th-hotel-milestones?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Accor** | **Handwritten Collection**, **MGallery**, **Emblems Collection** | Midscale/upscale, upper-upscale and luxury. Accor emphasizes flexible standards and conversion of existing independent hotels. ([group.accor.com](https://group.accor.com/en/news-stories/collection-brands-handwritten-emblems-mgallery?utm_source=openai)) |
| **IHG** | **Vignette Collection** | Upper-upscale/luxury collection; designed for independent conversions with limited compromise to property identity. **voco** is also frequently considered, although it is a conversion-friendly conventional brand rather than a true soft brand. ([ihgplc.com](https://www.ihgplc.com/en/news-and-media/news-releases/2025/ihg-hotels-resorts-debuts-9-brands-in-13-countries-across-europe?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Hyatt** | **The Unbound Collection by Hyatt**, **JdV by Hyatt**, sometimes **Destination by Hyatt** | Lifestyle upper-upscale/luxury, boutique and resort-led projects. Unbound expressly allows properties to maintain independence and individuality. ([hyatt.com](https://www.hyatt.com/development/ourbrands/theunboundcollectionbyhyatt?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Radisson** | **Radisson Individuals**, sometimes **Radisson Collection** | Upscale through luxury. Radisson Individuals is particularly conversion-oriented, with limited capital investment and retention of the hotel’s identity. ([radissonhotels.com](https://www.radissonhotels.com/en-us/corporate/development-opportunities/our-brands?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Wyndham** | **Trademark Collection**, **Registry Collection Hotels** | Upper-midscale/upscale through luxury; positioned as flexible alternatives for one-of-a-kind hotels. ([development.wyndhamhotels.com](https://development.wyndhamhotels.com/convert-your-existing-hotel?utm_source=openai)) |
| **BWH Hotels** | **BW Signature Collection**, **BW Premier Collection**, **WorldHotels Distinctive, Crafted, Elite or Luxury** | Midmarket through luxury; often relevant for owners prioritizing independent operation and lighter brand overlay. ([development.bwhhotels.com](https://development.bwhhotels.com/content/luxury-hotels/en_US/hotel-development/information.html?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Choice** | **Ascend Hotel Collection** | Boutique/upscale independent hotels; more market-dependent in Europe. |
| **Minor Hotels** | **Colbert Collection**, **Minor Reserve Collection** | Newer premium/luxury collection options aimed at conversion-led growth in Europe; Colbert offers flexible standards and streamlined onboarding. ([media.minorhotels.com](https://media.minorhotels.com/en-GLO/259745-minor-hotels-sharpens-growth-agenda-for-2026/?utm_source=openai)) |

### Affiliation-style alternatives

Owners wanting still less brand control may also consider **Design Hotels**, **Preferred Hotels & Resorts**, **Small Luxury Hotels of the World**, **The Leading Hotels of the World**, or similar representation/consortium arrangements. These can provide distribution, sales and marketing support while generally preserving more independence than a franchise, although loyalty-program access and commercial integration vary. Design Hotels, for example, offers distribution and access to Marriott Bonvoy for participating properties while hotels remain independently owned and operated. ([designhotels.com](https://www.designhotels.com/about/become-a-member-hotel/?utm_source=openai))

### Practical “first-call” shortlist

For most European conversion exercises, the most frequently benchmarked group is:

- **Tribute / Autograph**
- **Curio / Tapestry**
- **MGallery / Handwritten**
- **Vignette**
- **Unbound / JdV**
- **Radisson Individuals**
- **Trademark**
- **WorldHotels**

The right comparison should examine more than the headline brand flexibility: **PIP cost, retained hotel name, design freedom, mandatory systems, loyalty contribution, franchise versus management availability, territorial protection, contract term, guarantees/key money and exit provisions** often determine which option is genuinely most flexible.
